_help: Copy this file to config.json and fill in the paths. Every path on your machine lives here and nowhere else. Any key can be overridden on a command line: --set exe_tip=C:/somewhere/walk_window.exe
exe_tip: C:/path/to/walk_window.exe built from THIS branch (build.py puts it in out_dir/exes/tip/)
exe_base: C:/path/to/walk_window.exe built BEFORE this work (any build of lead/audio-snapshot, for example the shipped 0.9.1 dev build)
repo: C:/path/to/your/sm64ds tree (the one on branch cloud/audiohq1)
